items.title: Obtain and renew Maryland trader's license from the Baltimore City Clerk of the Circuit Court
items.authority: Clerk of the Circuit Court for Baltimore City
items.description: A retail or wholesale seller in a fixed location needs a trader's license from the Clerk of the Circuit Court. The license year runs May 1 to April 30, the fee rises with the average commercial inventory (from $15, up to $2,125 in Baltimore City), and renewal requires proof that state taxes are paid or covered by a payment arrangement.

feeDetail.note: by average inventory; up to $2,125 in Baltimore City
